issue.title: Workspace preparation failures are reported as a bare 'Failed to prepare workspace' with the underlying git/update error discarded
issue.description:
`prepare_workspace_if_needed` turns every workspace-preparation failure into a bare
`RuntimeError("Failed to prepare workspace")`, discarding the reason. The helper it
calls, `prepare_workspace(...)`, returns a bare `bool`, so the git/update error that
actually failed is never surfaced, logged, or attached to the failed run. The operator
is left with a traceback that names only the guard that raised it.

Observed on 2026-09-20 while launching soak probes for epic phase sase-142.4 (proposing
bead: sase-142.4 note #5). Probe `0od` ran in the `home` project and failed after
`Updating workspace to origin/master...` printed; the run log
(`~/.sase/workflows/202609/home_ace-run-260920_161333.txt`) ends there and then raises.
Two sibling probes (`0ob`, `0oc`) on other workspaces of the same project succeeded from
the same launch request, so this is specific to that workspace's state, not to the
project or the request. The root cause of the underlying update failure could not be
investigated *because* the reason was discarded.

Secondary effect: the failed run holds its workspace (`home_12`, under
`/home/bryan/.local/state/sase/workspaces/home-a52565cc/`) until the agent is dismissed
in the TUI, so a silent preparation failure also removes a workspace slot from the pool
with no explanation of what to fix.

Remediation direction: make `prepare_workspace` report why it failed (raise a typed
error or return a result carrying stderr/exit status) and include that reason in the
`RuntimeError` message and the run log, so the next occurrence is diagnosable from the
artifact alone.

task_type_fields.impact: Any workspace-preparation failure is undiagnosable from the run artifact, and the failed run holds its workspace slot until dismissed in the TUI. Cost observed: 1 of 3 launched soak probes lost with no recoverable cause, plus one pinned workspace.
task_type_fields.location: src/sase/axe/run_agent_runner_setup.py:prepare_workspace_if_needed (~line 152) and the prepare_workspace(...) bool return it checks
task_type_fields.repro: Launch an agent run into a project workspace whose checkout cannot fast-forward to origin/master (observed: home project, workspace home_12, ace-run 20260920161333). The run prints "=== Preparing Workspace ===" then "Updating workspace to origin/master..." and fails with RuntimeError("Failed to prepare workspace"); no stderr, exit status, or git message from the failed update appears anywhere in ~/.sase/workflows/202609/home_ace-run-260920_161333.txt.
